pages.title: Autumn Serenade
pages.text: Orange Tulip · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Orange Tulip Tea Bag in a teapot with water; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)Before the gates of excellence, the gods have placed sweat.$(br2)— Hesiod, Works and Days

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: Harvesting mature crops multiplies drops; nearby drops drift to you; farmland is not destroyed.$(br2)$(br2)Harvest 3:00
